ada.adaCustomCopy: Our ADA accessible seating is located in Section A Row B. For General Admission events, you may purchase a ticket and inquire about sitting in our ADA section when you arrive for the show. For Reserved Seat events, please purchase the accessible seating designated with the wheelchair symbol in Section A Row B. You may also contact the venue for assistance. Enjoy the show!

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday-Friday; 11:00am-7:00pm. Open all evening until 2am on night of shows.

venues.parkingDetail: There are several parking decks and surface lots in the area ranging from $5-$15. Closest parking is located at 75 Martin Luther King Jr. Dr, SW, Atlanta, GA 30303.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This is an accessible venue. Patrons requesting accessible seating may purchase and use a regular general admission ticket.

generalInfo.generalRule: No outside food or beverages (this includes alcohol), weapons of any kind, illegal substances or drug paraphernalia, pets (exception of service animal), professional cameras, GoPros and selfie sticks, chairs, skateboards, large chains or spiked jewelry (spikes longer than 3/4 of an inch), coolers, umbrellas, backpacks or large bags. Small bags are subject to search.
